title: Pollak's Minimax Quickest Change Detection: Non-Asymptotic Optimality
summary: Although Pollak's minimax formulation is one of the central frameworks in quickest change detection (QCD), the strongest general optimality results available for it are predominantly \emph{asymptotic}, applying as the average run-length-to-false-alarm constraint, $γ$, tends to infinity. Exact results for finite $γ$ have previously been available only for special models or restricted regimes.
